title: Tek Chand v. State of U.P. — recovery certificate and restoration of supply
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J.; Abhinava Upadhya, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; relegated to Consumer Forum and restoration application.
headnote: The Allahabad High Court declined to entertain a writ seeking quashing of a recovery certificate for electricity dues where the consumer had already approached the District Consumer Forum and the amount had been recovered. The petitioner was left to pursue that claim before the Forum under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and to apply to the competent authority for restoration of connection.
facts: Tek Chand sought quashing of a recovery certificate dated 23 August 2012 issued by the Executive Engineer for Rs 89,685 plus charges as electricity dues. He had already filed a claim petition before the District Consumer Forum claiming damages and disputing those dues. Counsel submitted that the entire amount had been collected forcefully from him and that his electricity connection had still not been restored despite payment.

holding_units.topic: recovery of dues and restoration of connection
holding_units.holding: A writ challenging a recovery certificate for electricity dues will not be entertained where the consumer has already approached the District Consumer Forum and the dues have been recovered. The claim may be pursued before the Forum under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and restoration of connection may be sought by application to the competent authority. Writ dismissed.
holding_units.flag: Order cites the Supply Code generally with no clause number. It treats the District Consumer Forum as under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Validity of the recovery certificate and the electricity dues
not_decided.note: Left to the pending claim before the District Consumer Forum.

not_decided.point: Entitlement to restoration of the electricity connection
not_decided.note: Left to an application before the competent authority.
